svg.title: Agent orchestration — 100+ AI agents, one harness
svg.desc: Agent orchestration panel. A glowing orchestrator core coordinates six role hubs — Planner, Architect, Builders, Reviewers, Verifiers, Release — and 100+ agents grouped by role on the outer rings, with data packets flowing from the orchestrator to each hub and agent and back. Beside it: 100+ agents in parallel, "One harness, every role of a software team", and a harness log: harness.spawn planner ok; fan-out 100+ agents running; rag.retrieve top-k 12 grounded; review adversarial 3/3 pass; verify typecheck+e2e green; release main shipped. Below, four pillars: Orchestrate — Harnesses, subagents and workflows running 100+ agents at once. Ground — RAG over embeddings and vector search, plus MCP for live context. Act — Tool calling and automations wired into GitHub, Slack and clouds. Verify — Evals, guardrails and adversarial review before anything ships.

text.tspan: every role of a software team.
